title: Synthetic certificate/hostname continuity
objective: Select certificate/hostname combinations; reject an invalid eligible destination.
banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
preconditions: Standard browser with local JavaScript; no server, account, framework, or management access
Fixed old and candidate eligible destinations, parked ineligible, browser/service required clients
All certificate, hostname, trust, validity, TLS, and eligibility fields are teaching DATA ONLY
Old uses a fixed valid trusted baseline; no candidate initially admitted
actions: Select fixed hostname/certificate/inventory and rehearse four synthetic client checks
Inspect positive, negative, and unknown outcomes at every eligible destination
Check admission; reject invalid, unmeasured, stale, or unknown candidate evidence
Reset current controls with retained immutable history, fixed allowance, and restored keyboard focus

syntheticInputs.historyLifetime: Immutable privately issued in-memory state; current reset retains history and allowance

expectedAssertions: Every eligible destination/client must pass hostname, trust, validity, and TLS checks before candidate admission
Wrong hostname, failed trust/validity/TLS rejects the candidate while old remains admitted
Unknown trust/TLS and absent evidence cannot count as successful continuity
Parked is excluded, not a fabricated success or a reason to reject valid eligible destinations
A correct rejection passes the gate verifier only; measured fail/unknown client outcomes remain counted
New selection or rehearsal invalidates old candidate approval without erasing history
Exact typed input and privately issued immutable state guards reject fabrication, repeats, and excess attempts
Keyboard, announced errors, retained-history reset, script failure, and restrictive CSP are observed in the real browser
limits: Fixed teaching DATA ONLY; no certificate issuance/installation, credential/private-key inspection, or trust/TLS/system/DNS/endpoint configuration
No cloud, IaC, scaffolding, identity, credentials, deployment, spending, installs, downloads, frameworks, or shared edits
Offline Playwright 1.56.1, signed installed Edge 156, Node 22 tooling only; not production Node 24
Published isolated.cjs 53c0c0d SHA256 86c80bc2ce52f828a96b176056706c60970be4367b085dc0919d3bfce86cc055 only; lifecycle remains unqualified
Read-only normal verification; CAPTURE_BROWSER_EVIDENCE=1 is deliberate evidence capture only

acceptance.credit: At most one A-S103 frozen S unit; no test, repair, refinement, or publication credit
